title: Great Brak River (Green Haven, approx.): man, 52, stabbed dead at home, 11 Oct

story: Police say a 52-year-old man was stabbed in the chest with a knife during an argument with his wife at their house in Green Haven, Wolwedans, Great Brak River, just before 16:00 on Sunday 11 October, and was declared dead at the scene. His wife, 52, was arrested at the scene and faces a murder charge (Mossel Bay Advertiser).
